text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Fi (Iklan Digital)

(Jabatan Penyiaran Malaysia) 2026.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 20 April 2026.

Tafsiran

2. Dalam Perintah ini —

"iklan digital" ertinya kaedah pemasaran dalam pelbagai bentuk termasuklah

tetapi tidak terhad kepada imej, audio, video, teks atau sepanduk yang menggunakan

platform digital atau papan elektronik untuk mempromosikan suatu produk,

perkhidmatan, jenama, aktiviti, apa-apa perkara lain atau maklumat lain bagi

menyampaikan mesej kepada pengguna;

"Ketua Pengarah" ertinya Ketua Pengarah Jabatan Penyiaran Malaysia;

"papan elektronik" ertinya suatu sistem paparan yang menggunakan komponen

elektronik untuk memaparkan maklumat dalam bentuk imej, audio, video atau teks

kecuali sepanduk yang melibatkan penggunaan Paparan Diod Pemancar Cahaya (LED),

Paparan Hablur Cecair (LCD) atau teknologi paparan lain untuk menunjukkan

kandungan dalam format digital yang kandungannya boleh dikemas kini dan

mempunyai ciri interaktif dan keupayaan multimedia; dan

"platform digital" ertinya aplikasi yang menggunakan perkhidmatan capaian

internet yang membolehkan interaksi, penciptaan dan perkongsian kandungan

termasuklah tetapi tidak terhad kepada penstriman langsung video, penstriman

langsung audio, video atas permintaan (VOD) atau audio atas permintaan (AOD) yang

didaftarkan di bawah akaun Jabatan Penyiaran Malaysia.

Fi dan pembayaran fi

3. (1) Fi yang ditetapkan dalam ruang (3) Jadual Pertama hendaklah dibayar

kepada Ketua Pengarah bagi tempahan slot perkhidmatan untuk iklan digital yang

dipaparkan di platform digital mengikut kategori yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (1) dan

kuantiti yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (2).

(2) Fi yang ditetapkan dalam ruang (2) Jadual Kedua hendaklah dibayar

kepada Ketua Pengarah bagi tempahan slot perkhidmatan untuk iklan digital yang

dipaparkan di papan elektronik mengikut kategori yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (1)

dan hendaklah dikenakan mengikut tempoh paparan bagi setiap hari pengiklanan.

Peremitan fi

4. Ketua Pengarah boleh meremitkan fi yang ditetapkan di bawah Perintah ini

secara keseluruhan atau sebahagian, dan sama ada secara am atau dalam mana-mana

hal atau kelas hal yang tertentu.

FEES ACT 1951

FEES (DIGITAL ADVERTISEMENT)

(DEPARTMENT OF BROADCASTING MALAYSIA) ORDER 2026

IN exercise of the powers conferred by sections 3 and 10 of the Fees Act 1951 [Act 209],

the Yang di-Pertuan Agong makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Fees (Digital Advertisement)

(Department of Brodcasting Malaysia) Order 2026.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 20 April 2026.

Interpretation

2. In this Order—

"digital advertisement" means a marketing method in various forms including

but not limited to images, audios, videos, texts or banners which use a digital platform

or an electronic board to promote a product, service, brand, activity, any other matter or

other information to convey messages to users;

"Director General" means the Director General of the Department of

Broadcasting Malaysia;

"electronic board" means a display system which uses electronic components to

display information in forms of image, audio, video or text except banners that involve

the use of Light Emitting Diode Display (LED), Liquid Crystal Display (LCD) or other

display technology to indicate content in a digital format of which its contents can be

updated and has interactive features and multimedia capabilities; and

"digital platform" means an application which utilizes internet access service

that enables interaction, creation and sharing of content including but not limited to live

video streaming, live audio streaming, video on demand (VOD) or audio on demand

(AOD) that is registered under the account of the Department of Broadcasting Malaysia.

Fees and payments of fees

3. (1) The fees prescribed in column (3) of the First Schedule shall be paid to the

Director General for reservation of a service slot for a digital advertisement displayed

on a digital platform in accordance with the category specified in column (1) and the

quantity specified in column (2).

(2) The fees prescribed in columns (2) of the Second Schedule shall be paid to

the Director General for reservation of a service slot for a digital advertisement

displayed on an electronic board in accordance with the category specified in

column (1) and shall be charged in accordance with the display duration for each day of

advertising.

Remission of fees

4. The Director General may remit the fees prescribed under this Order wholly or

in part, and either generally or in any particular case or class of cases.

FIRST SCHEDULE

[Subparagraph 3(1)]

1. The fee imposed for reservation of a service slot for a digital advertisement

displayed on a digital platform is as follows:

2. For the purposes of this Order, the metric used is as follows:

(a) CPM is cost per thousand impressions and 1 CPM is equivalent to 1,000

impressions;

(b) if 1 CPM = RM50.00, this means the customer pays RM50.00 for 1,000

impressions.

3. The total fee calculation for a digital advertisement displayed on a digital platform

is determined based on the following formula:

(a) impression = total payment X 1,000;

RM100.00:

Impression = 100 X 1,000 = 2,000 Impressions

For the paid amount of RM100.00, the client will get 2,000 impressions on
